title: QA_Platform_convert_with_unknown_auction_type_must_not_500
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox RFQ: published (status active), bid window still open, one line item in KG, closing mode line_item_based, no bids, never converted. rfx_project_enabled is ON for PROCOL DEMO. The single data row deliberately names a delivery location that does not exist (buyer_hub uuid Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==, id 999999999) and the audience list is empty, so even if the guard under test regressed the conversion is still refused later, inside the same transaction, with 125 'Delivery location not found' (trade_controller_helper.rb:855) and rolled back — nothing is created and nobody is invited.
steps: 1. POST /trade/move_to_auction on the sandbox RFQ with configurations.auction_config = "serial_bidding" (not a member of the auction_config enum).
2. Observe the status code.
expectedResult: Must be a clean 4xx. Today it is expected to crash: no guard before RfqToAuction::CreateService reads auction_config (trade_controller.rb:963-999 only special-cases dutch/knockout), and change_rfq_info assigns it straight to the enum (app/services/rfq_to_auction/create_service.rb:231) — Rails 7.0 raises ArgumentError "'serial_bidding' is not a valid auction_config", which is not a CustomException, is re-raised (create_service.rb:99-103) and is not rescued by ApiController → HTTP 500. The transaction rolls back, so the sandbox RFQ is untouched.
rationale: Valid types are rank, price, rank_and_price, traffic_light, knockout, dutch, book_building (trade_request.rb:166). 'Serial bidding' is a staggered line-item mode, not a type; a client that sends it (or 'english', or 'Rank') gets an untyped 500 instead of a validation error.

title: QA_Platform_convert_without_auction_type_silently_becomes_rank
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox RFQ: published (status active), bid window still open, one line item in KG, closing mode line_item_based, no bids, never converted. rfx_project_enabled is ON for PROCOL DEMO. The single data row deliberately names a delivery location that does not exist (buyer_hub uuid Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==, id 999999999) and the audience list is empty, so even if the guard under test regressed the conversion is still refused later, inside the same transaction, with 125 'Delivery location not found' (trade_controller_helper.rb:855) and rolled back — nothing is created and nobody is invited.
steps: 1. POST /trade/move_to_auction on the sandbox RFQ with configurations.auction_config = null.
2. Read the error.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with code 125 'Delivery location not found' — i.e. the request got all the way to creating the line items: a missing auction type is not refused; set_configurations_for_trade defaults it to rank (trade_controller_helper.rb:3521, 3534). If a guard for a missing type is ever added the message changes and this case reports 'rejected for a different reason' — update it then.
rationale: Documents that the conversion endpoint never asks which auction the buyer wanted; a client bug that drops the field silently produces a rank auction.

title: QA_Platform_convert_into_book_building_passes_the_configuration_step
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the sandbox RFQ: published (status active), bid window still open, one line item in KG, closing mode line_item_based, no bids, never converted. rfx_project_enabled is ON for PROCOL DEMO. steps: 1. POST /trade/move_to_auction on the sandbox RFQ with configurations.auction_config = "book_building".
2. Read the error.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 with code 125 'Delivery location not found' — book_building is accepted by the conversion (it only forces line_item_based closing, trade_controller_helper.rb:3349-3353) and the request is stopped only by the bogus delivery location. The dashboard never offers book building on conversion (constants/index.js:110-118 has no tab for it), so the API accepts a type the product does not support here.
rationale: The create path refuses book_building inside a basket (474, trade_controller.rb:142-144) but the conversion has no allow-list of types at all.

title: QA_Platform_convert_unknown_stage_is_refused_95
preconditions: A well-formed but non-existent stage uuid (id 999999999). Refused before RfqToAuction::CreateService runs, so nothing is written.

rationale: The correctly-keyed version of the not-found case: the older AUC-CONV-001 sends trade_request_id, which ParamsAuth never decodes, so it cannot tell a missing stage from a mis-keyed one.

title: QA_Platform_convert_without_any_stage_id_is_refused_95
preconditions: No stage id at all in the body. Refused before RfqToAuction::CreateService runs, so nothing is written.

rationale: A missing mandatory field should be a 2/insufficient-parameters answer; today it masquerades as not-found, which hides client bugs.

title: QA_Platform_convert_the_journey_rfq_a_second_time_is_refused
preconditions: Runs only when auction.convert is ticked: {{pricingTradeUuid}} is the journey's RFQ that the journey converted into {{auctionTradeUuid}} (a CLOSED auction with one QA-vendor bid, awarded from). The body also carries the bogus delivery location so a regressed guard still cannot create a second auction.
steps: 1. POST /trade/move_to_auction with trade_request_uuid = {{pricingTradeUuid}} (already converted by the journey).
2. Read the refusal.
expectedResult: Refused with HTTP 422. Expected code 94 (An auction has already been made for this event.) from TradeRequest.where(parent_id:).not_cancelled_or_withdrawn.exists? (trade_controller.rb:973); if the award closed the RFQ first, code 95 (Trade Request not found, trade_controller.rb:965-969) is equally correct. Never a second child auction.
rationale: Two auctions hanging off one RFQ would split the vendors' bids and break 'latest stage' awarding (826).

title: QA_Platform_convert_the_auction_itself_is_refused
preconditions: Runs only when auction.convert is ticked: {{pricingTradeUuid}} is the journey's RFQ that the journey converted into {{auctionTradeUuid}} (a CLOSED auction with one QA-vendor bid, awarded from). The body carries the bogus delivery location as a backstop.
steps: 1. POST /trade/move_to_auction with trade_request_uuid = {{auctionTradeUuid}} (the auction, not the RFQ).
expectedResult: Refused with HTTP 422: code 93 (Trade is already of auction type, trade_controller.rb:979) while the auction is still status active, or code 95 (Trade Request not found) once the award has closed it. Never a nested auction.
rationale: The older AUC-CONV-002 covers this but keys the id as trade_request_id (never decoded), so it always gets 95; this is the correctly-keyed version.

title: QA_Platform_knockout_start_price_is_not_checked_when_the_rfq_has_no_bids

title: QA_Platform_convert_with_end_before_start_reaches_line_item_creation
